Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s correct search results for “Madeleine (1950 film)” and conflated them with a different work, “Madeline (1952)” (an animated short by Robert “Bobe” Cannon). This disambiguation failure led to selecting the wrong director and nationality, and prematurely marking the task complete despite the visible Wikipedia snippet indicating the correct 1950 British film directed by David Lean.
